description: This file defines the Address controller class within the Opencart admin module for customer address management. It includes methods for listing, editing, creating, and deleting customer addresses, handling form submissions, and rendering relevant views.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer addresses in the admin panel, includes methods for index, getAddress, form, and save operations.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer addresses in the admin panel, includes methods for address listing, form handling, and deletion.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the language, and outputs the list of addresses for a customer.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves address data for a given customer and prepares the data for rendering.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Prepares the address form for adding or editing an address, loads necessary data including customer info, country list, and custom fields.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a new address or editing an existing one, with validation and permission checks.
